name: octocode
description: Octocode skills for evidence-first code research, idea validation, live Chrome DevTools, documentation, prompt optimization, skill authoring, and worker delegation.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first research, critique, and agent workflows
interface.longDescription: Agent skills for Octocode: research local and GitHub code with exact citations; validate ideas against prior art; collect live Chrome DevTools/CDP evidence; write and copyedit docs; roast code with a repair path; author and sync Agent Skills; optimize prompts; and spawn or synthesize workers.
defaultPrompt: Research this question across local code, GitHub, and packages with exact evidence
Validate this idea with prior art and a Build / Prototype / Narrow / Park verdict
Collect live Chrome DevTools evidence for this page (DOM, network, HAR)
